info.title: FactoryJet Lead Intake API
info.description: Submit a project inquiry / lead to FactoryJet. Delivers the inquiry to the FactoryJet team (founder replies within 24 hours). Intended for agents acting on a consenting user's behalf. See also the agent skills at /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json.

post.description: Records the inquiry and notifies the FactoryJet team. Only submit with the user's real, consented contact details.

service.description: Interest area, e.g. ecommerce | web-design | ai-seo | ai-agent | audit.

message.description: What the user needs, in their words.

source.description: Identifier for the submitting agent, e.g. "ai-agent".
